# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1272
**Eventing SSOT: Python thin-client cutover of core/events.py over the A1 wire seam (edit-only)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** PY emitters currently write the stream directly; the Go core will own emit/seq. Must cut over with zero
consumer changes. -> core/events.py (edit-only, no new module) delegates emit to the Go core via core/go_host while keeping its
public API and envelope back-compat; reads remain compatible.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1272
  prior_decisions : ['BI-PF-0387/BI-PF-0388: Go-first for new work; sensitive logic in go/pfcore invoked via A1 wire seam.', 'BI-PF-0233: Observability SSOT; single writer per stream; events.jsonl path conventions.', 'BI-PF-1267: Eventing SSOT contracts (formal envelope+seq, subscription, alert-rule, webhook HMAC).', 'BI-PF-1268: Event Core (Go); append-only store with monotonic sequence assignment and cursor-based read.']
  existing_path   : ['Python event emitter: core/events.py:43 (emit function appending directly to JSONL).', 'Go host bridge: core/go_host.py:86 (event_append and event_read wrappers over A1 wire contract).', 'Go event store: go/pfcore/eventstore.go:207 (EventAppendOp assigning monotonic seq under lock).']
  assumptions     : ['go_host.event_append() assigns monotonic sequence numbers and persists to events.jsonl cleanly.', 'Fail-safe fallback to direct JSONL append is triggered if go_host returns ok=False or is unbuilt.']
  divergences     : ['None. Edit-only cutover strictly aligned with BI-PF-1272 specification and store-registry rules.']
  open_questions  : []
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  core/events.py delegates event emission to Go core via go_host.event_append. | aligned | core/go_host.py:86 | Update core/events.py:emit() to invoke go_host.event_append(p, ev).
  Fallback strangler path preserves local file write if Go host is unavailable. | aligned | core/events.py:69 | Implement try/except fallback to local JSONL append when Go host call fails.
  Zero breaking changes for existing 50+ Python callers. | aligned | core/events.py:43 | Keep all function signatures (emit, read, counts, path) and return values identical.
  API CHECK: dev library cutover requires no public HTTP API changes. | aligned | config/store-registry.json | needs_api=false (HTTP SSE endpoint scheduled for subsequent item BI-PF-1274).
  AC CHECK: 5 detailed acceptance criteria verify Go delegation, fallback, and caller stability. | aligned | data/backlog/items/BI-PF-1272.json | 5 detailed ACs (each >= 40 chars) verified with dedicated unit and contract tests.
  Language Rule: Edit-only to existing shipped Python. | aligned | scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py | Verdict: OK (no new shipped Python; edits allowed).

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Implementation cleanly delivers all 5 acceptance criteria for BI-PF-1272.
  core/events.py:emit() delegates event emission to the Go core via go_host.event_append, receiving and populating monotonic seq.
  Fail-safe strangler fallback preserves local JSONL emission if the Go host is unavailable, preventing caller disruption.
  100% backward compatibility maintained across TYPES, EVENT_VERSION, path(), read(), counts(), and all existing event test suites pass.
  Dedicated contract tests verify monotonic seq assignment, fallback resilience, and envelope parity without duplicate writes. Recommendation: APPROVE.
